class.name: MaszynaCarDriver
class.brief_description: The original's driver of a car, one for every car.
class.description: The driver a scenery seats in a car (TController of [code]is_car()[/code]), by the car's [VehicleServer] handle - no driver object per car. It drives as the original's drives a car without a timetable: it starts the engine and puts the head lights and red markers on, shunts at its shunting velocity (40 km/h) at most, slows down for and stops within its proximity of what the memories read by its roads' passive events say ([code]SetVelocity[/code]), moves off three seconds after the way clears, and sounds the horn for a scenery's [code]Warning_signal[/code]. Following the vehicle ahead, keeping the roads' limits and turning back at a road's end are [RoadVehicleServer]'s, by the car's configuration. It acts on the car by its commands only.

method.name: vehicle_attach
method.description: The car - a [RoadVehicleServer] vehicle - is driven from now on; [param velocity] is its scenery velocity [km/h], whose orders it starts with. A freed car is let go of on its own.

method.name: vehicle_detach
method.description: The car is driven no more.

method.name: vehicle_handle_command
method.description: An order of the scenery for the car's driver - what an event the car ran sends it ([MaszynaVehicleCommandAction]); a car's driver takes only [code]Warning_signal[/code]: the horns of [param value2]'s bits for [param value1] seconds.

method.name: vehicle_is_attached
method.description: Whether [param vehicle] is a car this driver drives.
